### 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you would like to see.

### 🎯 Motivation / Use Case
What problem does this solve, or how does it improve the user experience?

### 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Details
Detailed explanation of how the feature should work (e.g. adding a new scraper, UI component, filter option, etc.).

### 💡 Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or features you have considered.
